overview.title: Business finance, tax services and family office support under one roof.
overview.text: Pick a service to see what it covers, or call or text and talk it through with our team.

services.title: Accounting and Bookkeeping Support
services.summary: Full service bookkeeping for your business.
services.text: As a business owner you have more important things to do than manage payroll, pay bills, create invoicing and reconcile bank accounts. We take care of all aspects of your business accounting.
services.lead: We take care of all aspects of your business accounting so you can get back to the job of running your business and generating profits.

covers.title: Bank reconciliation
covers.text: Accounts reconciled as part of full service accounting support, so your records stay current.

covers.title: Invoicing and bill payment
covers.text: Invoices created and bills paid on the schedule your business works to.

covers.title: Real-time records
covers.text: Clients have access to an updated view of their financial reports within 24 hours of receipt of accounting documentation.

services.title: Accounts Payable
services.text: We handle all aspects of accounts payable from payment of bills, vendor tracking, processing of W9s, 1099 reporting and compliance.
services.lead: You choose your level of input, from viewing and approving every bill payment to being completely hands-off, and we'll make sure your payables are handled professionally.

covers.title: Bill payment
covers.text: Payment of bills on your schedule, with as much or as little approval from you as you want.

covers.title: Vendor tracking
covers.text: Vendor records kept current so payments and reporting line up.

covers.title: W9s and 1099s
covers.text: Processing of W9s, 1099 reporting and compliance.

services.title: Accounts Receivable
services.text: No matter your size or process, we can help with accounts receivable from start to finish, whether that is complex contracts and proposals, job costing or straight customer invoicing.
services.lead: We can brand your A/R and carry it over the finish line as your outsourced finance department.

covers.title: Customer invoicing
covers.text: Straight invoicing or complex billing, branded as your own finance department.

covers.title: Contracts and proposals
covers.text: Receivables managed against complex contracts and proposals.

covers.title: Job costing
covers.text: Tracking what each job earns and what it costs to deliver.

services.title: Payroll and H/R
services.text: We offer payroll solutions that meet your business' needs and enable you to spend time doing what you do best, functioning as your outsourced human resources office.
services.lead: We handle anything from complex commission calculations, wage garnishments and multiple payroll schedules in addition to establishing standard procedures and employee handbooks.

covers.title: Payroll processing
covers.text: Multiple payroll schedules, complex commission calculations and wage garnishments.

covers.title: Tax reporting and withholdings
covers.text: Payroll handled for all U.S. states including all required tax reporting, withholdings, garnishments and vendor 1099 reporting.

covers.title: Outsourced H/R
covers.text: Standard procedures and employee handbooks established alongside the payroll work.

services.title: Collections
services.text: Collection on open A/R is a business owner's biggest nightmare. Our staff has a track record for collecting in the stickiest of situations.
services.lead: We get your invoice on the priority payment list and handle collections in a professional and timely manner while keeping you informed every step of the way.

covers.title: Priority payment
covers.text: Getting your invoice onto the customer's priority payment list.

covers.title: Professional handling
covers.text: Collections carried out in a professional and timely manner, with the customer relationship intact.

covers.title: Kept informed
covers.text: You are kept informed every step of the way.

services.title: Financial Reporting
services.summary: Standard and custom reports, on your schedule.
services.text: From custom commission reporting, complex job tracking, weekly payables check-ins or standard financial reports, our team can generate or custom-create any report needed.
services.lead: Always know where you stand financially with our quick response team and reporting options customized to your own business, on the real-time schedule you desire.

covers.title: Standard financial reports
covers.text: The reports you expect, produced on the schedule you ask for.

covers.title: Custom reporting
covers.text: Custom commission reporting, complex job tracking and weekly payables check-ins.

covers.title: Proactive KPI tracking
covers.text: KPI tracking and executive financial reports, so nothing waits until year-end to surface.

services.title: CFO Services
services.text: Our CFO Services mean you can have your own finance department at your fingertips. Your clients don't have to know that your CFO is not on-site.
services.lead: DMS offers a boutique, concierge type accounting, business management and CFO/Controller support service, with direct communication at the level your own clients expect.

covers.title: CFO and controller support
covers.text: Senior financial oversight without a full-time hire on the payroll.

covers.title: Executive reporting
covers.text: Proactive KPI tracking and executive financial reports to steer decisions.

covers.title: Client-facing work
covers.text: Direct communication with your customers at the highest level, in your name.

services.title: Business Tax Services
services.summary: Federal, state, partnership and S-Corp returns.
services.text: Your business tax return should be a reflection of well-maintained financial records and thoughtful planning throughout the year. We prepare and file returns while coordinating the tax process with your accounting.
services.lead: By understanding the complete financial picture, we can help ensure that your tax filings are accurate, timely, and supported by reliable financial information.

covers.title: Business returns
covers.text: Federal and state business tax returns, including partnership, corporate and S-Corporation returns.

covers.title: Documents and compliance
covers.text: Tax document review and organization, plus tax compliance and filing support.

covers.title: Coordinated with your books
covers.text: Coordination of tax information with your accounting records and year-end reporting.

covers.title: Who it is for
covers.text: We offer our full tax portfolio of services to existing accounting and bookkeeping clients.

services.title: Tax Planning
services.summary: Planning before the return is due.
services.text: The best time to think about taxes is before the tax return is due. Tax planning is an ongoing process, and changes in income, investments, ownership structure or major purchases all have tax consequences.
services.lead: We work with clients throughout the year to help identify tax considerations before decisions are finalized, looking beyond the current return to how today's decisions affect your future tax position.

covers.title: Year-round analysis
covers.text: With over 30 years of tax preparation experience, we provide year-round analysis to reduce tax liability.

covers.title: Business decisions
covers.text: Reviewing business structure, income, expenses, distributions and retirement planning.

covers.title: Ahead of the decision
covers.text: Tax considerations raised before a purchase, sale or structure change is finalized.

services.title: Business Management Services
services.summary: Formation, cash flow, proposals and support.
services.text: Alongside the accounting, DMS helps with the decisions around it: forming a new entity, projecting cash flow, winning work with professional proposals and supporting you in litigation.
services.lead: Full service financial strategies to maximize profits and accelerate growth, from the day the entity is formed onward.

covers.title: New business formation
covers.text: A strong plan of action for a new venture, avoiding the common pitfalls many owners make when setting up a new business entity.

covers.title: Cash flow management
covers.text: Cash flow projections to get you on track, then support for your efforts as you move forward.

covers.title: Proposals and contracts
covers.text: Professional presentation software and our expertise in winning proposals, with electronic signatures and automatic invoicing.

covers.title: Litigation support
covers.text: The expertise of an experienced accountant to assist with documentation and backup that supports your position.

services.title: Fraud Protection and Mitigation
services.text: Occupational crime is most often committed by the most tenured, loyal and reliable employees, the very employees business owners trust with everything.
services.lead: DMS brings decades of experience in helping our clients uncover deeply embedded internal fraud and embezzlement, and in closing the gaps that let it happen.

covers.title: Internal controls
covers.text: We assess your internal control systems for efficiency and effectiveness, then recommend changes that make the company less vulnerable to fraudulent activity.

covers.title: Forensic accounting
covers.text: Decades of experience uncovering deeply embedded internal fraud and embezzlement.

covers.title: Privacy and confidentiality
covers.text: The fierce protection of our client's confidentiality and the security of their records is at the very top of our priority list.

services.title: Individual Tax Services
services.text: Personal taxes can become increasingly complicated as your financial life grows. We prepare individual returns in a way that is organized, efficient and as straightforward as possible.
services.lead: We take the time to understand your financial circumstances and ensure that the information supporting your return is complete and accurate.

covers.title: Individual returns
covers.text: Individual federal and state tax returns, including returns for business owners.

covers.title: Income reporting
covers.text: Investment and other income reporting, and rental and real estate tax reporting.

covers.title: Organization and review
covers.text: Tax document organization and review ahead of filing.

covers.title: Planning
covers.text: Year-end tax planning and coordination of personal and business tax considerations.

services.title: Family Office Accounting Support
services.summary: Personal bookkeeping, payroll and tax work.
services.text: Our range of accounting support services include reconciliation of all income and expenses, cash flow management and reporting to a client-facing dashboard for full transparency of records and cash status.
services.lead: A full suite of family office services from a team who values security and confidentiality above all else.

covers.title: Accounting and bookkeeping
covers.text: Reconciliation of all income and expenses, cash flow management and reporting to a client-facing dashboard.

covers.title: Payroll processing
covers.text: From a handful of household assistants to large groups of corporate employees, payroll for all U.S. states with the required tax reporting and withholdings.

covers.title: Tax planning with your preparer
covers.text: Should you have a tax preparer you wish to continue working with, we assist with income tax planning by preparing all financial records in coordination with them.

covers.title: Tax services
covers.text: Our full tax portfolio is available to existing Family Office clients only; we do not offer it as a standalone service.

services.title: Income and Expenses
services.summary: Income tracking, bill payment and royalties.
services.text: Our accounting support team handles the tracking and collection of income and receivables, timely deposit of payments and a detailed system to monitor income, advances and recoupments.
services.lead: Coordinating family financial, investment and lifestyle needs, down to the daily record keeping.

covers.title: Income management
covers.text: Tracking and collection of income and receivables, timely deposits, and monitoring of income, advances and recoupments.

covers.title: Bill payments
covers.text: Payment of all personal, household and business expenses with daily record keeping on a client-facing dashboard showing open, paid and disputed bills.

covers.title: Royalty review and auditing
covers.text: Our team is well versed in royalty agreements and reviews statements to ensure payments arrive on time and in full and that contractual obligations are met.

services.title: Budgeting and Financial Management
services.summary: Budgets, cash flow, contracts and entities.
services.text: Using our proven methodology, we work closely with your financial advisors to establish a budget that meets your day-to-day lifestyle spending needs and sustains your wealth.
services.lead: Allowing you the peace of mind to truly enjoy what you've created.

covers.title: Lifestyle budgeting
covers.text: A budget built with your financial advisors that covers day-to-day spending and manages wealth over the long run.

covers.title: Cash flow management
covers.text: Analysis of cash inflow and outflow against budgeted goals, with regular reporting to your investment or professional consultants.

covers.title: Contract review and SAG-AFTRA negotiations
covers.text: Years of experience reviewing SAG-AFTRA contracts and working with agencies to secure the most favorable terms.

covers.title: Union and guild declarations
covers.text: Monthly union reporting, guild audits and the day-to-day paperwork that keeps licenses, memberships and contractual obligations current.

covers.title: Structuring of entities
covers.text: Setup and filing of personally held and business entities in any US state, with structuring analysed for best tax practice alongside your legal counsel.

services.title: Security and Confidentiality
services.summary: Fraud prevention and VIP threat protection.
services.text: Confidentiality and the protection of our client's personal and financial resources is of utmost importance.
services.lead: Through our diligence in accounting and intimate knowledge of our client's spending habits, financial issues surface promptly and are resolved quickly, leading to immediate recognition of potential security risks, fraudulent activity or breaches of any kind.

covers.title: Fraud prevention
covers.text: Close knowledge of day-to-day spending means anything out of pattern is seen and dealt with quickly.

covers.title: VIP threat protection
covers.text: Clients with status in the entertainment and corporate industries handle highly valuable information. We provide a variety of security solutions to keep clients and their teams safe online.

process.title: Becoming our client
process.text: Our business financial onboarding, from a first look at your records to systems that run themselves.

steps.title: Establish
steps.text: A solid foundation, with a review and tightening up of your current accounting records so our team can manage your basic accounting support going forward.

steps.title: Determine
steps.text: Which services you wish to implement, one, some or all. We set forth a comprehensive proposal and price plan tailored to your needs, signed electronically.

steps.title: Move forward
steps.text: At your own pace. When you are ready, our team provides step-by-step direction managed by our detailed CRM tracking software.

steps.title: Dive in
steps.text: In Phase II we take a deep dive into understanding your workflow and implementing systems of AI for ongoing support and maintenance.

about.title: Be proactive. Leverage the most sophisticated technology. Fiercely protect our clients' wealth.
text: Simply put, this is our mission. We always keep in focus that our clients are profitable operations providing a means to realize their life dreams and care for their loved ones. We hold integrity, enthusiasm and persistence at the forefront of our values.

By being on the cutting edge of technology and employing some of the most creative, confident and inspired team players, we empower our clients to reach their fullest potential while DMS handles the necessary daily operation that undergirds their unique brand.

DMS is a virtual accounting and CFO company serving both small and large business clients, alongside a full suite of family office services. Clients come to us for a boutique, concierge type accounting, business management and CFO support service, delivered on a short turnaround.
"Superior service, long-term relationships, and a fierce protection of our client's confidentiality are the hallmarks of our commitment to those we serve." — Kimberlee Augustine, Founder

facts.heading: Client portal
facts.text: Clients sign in to the secure firm portal at securefirmportal.com to exchange documents with our team.

facts.heading: Sending documents securely
items: A secure, password-protected portal holds your tax returns, financial work papers and accounting database, reachable from work, home or on vacation
The portal exchanges working documents, scanned receipts and very large QuickBooks files between you and our team
New clients register for a portal account at securefirmportal.com; SecureSend delivers a file straight to a member of the firm without an account

facts.heading: Portal security
facts.text: Our client portal is hosted by CPA Site Solutions in SSAE 16 and SAS 70 Type II certified datacenters behind fourteen layers of security, including encrypted file storage, filename obfuscation, forced SSL transfer and detailed audit trails, fully compliant with Sarbanes-Oxley and Gramm-Leach-Bliley.

facts.heading: Privacy policy
facts.text: Our privacy policy is the one required by the Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act of 1999: we disclose no nonpublic personal information about clients or former clients to anyone except as permitted by law, and access inside the firm is restricted to the people who need it to serve you.
